1795-05-06 minus 49 weeks 6 days = minus (49*7 + 6) days = minus 349 days.  
1795 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Counting back: May 6 back 26 days → April 10.  
From April 10 back 349 - 26 = 323 days into previous year.  
1794 has 365 days. 365 - 323 = 42 days left in 1794 after going back 323 days from Dec 31.  
42 days from Jan 1, 1794 = Feb 11, 1794.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-02-11
